title: Labcorp president & CEO Adam Schechter sells $1.5m in company stock
summary: Adam H. Schechter, President & CEO of Labcorp Holdings Inc., sold 4,669 shares of company stock for approximately $1.5 million. title: L3Harris launches new facility in Rhode Island to produce undersea training systems
summary: L3Harris has opened a new 50,000-square-foot maritime production facility at ProvPort in Rhode Island, representing a $6 million investment. This facility will support the integration and testing of undersea training ranges for the US and partner nations, leveraging the local workforce and enhancing Rhode Island's role in undersea warfare technology. The move reinforces L3Harris's commitment to the state and its growing capabilities in defense.

title: Starbucks (SBUX) Stock Could Be 49% Overvalued After Q2 Beat
summary: Starbucks (SBUX) stock has seen a 27.0% gain year-to-date, but analysis by Simply Wall St suggests it may be significantly overvalued. Both a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model and P/E ratio comparison indicate the stock is trading at a premium, with the DCF model pointing to a 49.2% overvaluation. Despite a strong Q2 earnings beat and raised full-year guidance, the current share price appears to incorporate substantial future growth that may be difficult to sustain.

title: Hormel Stock And 2 Defensive U.S. Consumer Staples Picks For Dividend Investors
summary: Amidst stubborn inflation and economic uncertainties, this article highlights three defensive U.S. consumer staples stocks—Reynolds Consumer Products (REYN), Bunge Global (BG), and Hormel Foods (HRL)—that offer dividends and relative stability. It analyzes each company's financial profile, market position, and potential for income-focused investors looking for capital preservation. title: Spectacular new Morgan Stanley display lights up Times Square: ‘Broadway is a bit brighter’
summary: Morgan Stanley has unveiled a spectacular new 21,000-square-foot digital display at its 1585 Broadway headquarters in Times Square. The installation, which features 31.5 million pixels and frequently showcases "CRYPTO" messages, replaces an older display from 2015. Times Square Alliance president Tom Harris noted that this "significant investment" has made Broadway "a bit brighter."

title: EQT outlook raised to positive by S&P on debt reduction
summary: S&P Global Ratings has upgraded EQT Corp.'s outlook from stable to positive, affirming its 'BBB-' issuer credit rating, due to significant debt reduction. The natural gas company has repaid over $8.1 billion in debt since September 2024, lowering its total debt to $5.7 billion by June 2026. This positive outlook is based on expectations that EQT will continue to use free cash flow to reduce debt, aiming for a net debt target of $5 billion by 2027.

title: Amgen Stock And The Price Of A Promise
summary: Amgen recently raised its full-year revenue guidance, typically a positive signal, but its stock has not seen a significant celebratory pop. While the company's current performance is strong with multiple products showing double-digit growth, the market appears to have already factored this in. Investors are now looking for the next major catalyst, particularly from Amgen's drug pipeline, especially its experimental weight-loss treatment MariTide, to justify further stock appreciation.

title: Lululemon leads large-caps as a potential acquisition target with 79.8% fair value upside
summary: Lululemon Athletica is identified as a prime acquisition target among large-cap U.S. stocks due to its significant 79.8% fair value upside, strong financials, and premium brand status despite a recent stock decline. title: Constellium outlook raised to positive by Moody’s on strong results
summary: Moody's Ratings has upgraded Constellium SE's outlook from stable to positive, while affirming its Ba3 Corporate Family Rating, Ba3-PD Probability of Default Rating, and Ba3 backed senior unsecured ratings. This positive revision is attributed to Constellium's robust operating performance in the first half of 2026, which surpassed Moody's expectations, leading to significantly strengthened credit metrics despite flat shipments. The company's Moody’s-adjusted EBITDA increased by 110% to nearly $720 million, and it has begun using free cash flow for debt reduction, aligning with its financial policy targets.

title: Moody’s upgrades Rolls-Royce outlook on strong performance
summary: Moody’s Ratings has upgraded Rolls-Royce Holdings' outlook to positive from stable, affirming its A3 long-term issuer ratings due to strong performance across all business divisions and a conservative financial policy. The company's Civil Aerospace unit has shown resilience, complemented by sustained profit increases in its Defence and Power Systems businesses. Moody's anticipates continued profit growth from commercial and operational improvements, expecting Rolls-Royce to maintain a net cash position and execute significant share buybacks through 2028.

title: Bank of Montreal reveals XRP ETF holdings in $303B portfolio filing.
summary: Bank of Montreal (BMO), Canada's second-largest bank, has disclosed holdings in XRP-related ETFs within its U.S. portfolio, which is valued at over $303 billion as of June 2026. This includes shares in the REX-Osprey XRP ETF and ProShares Ultra XRP ETF, demonstrating how traditional financial institutions are gaining exposure to digital assets through regulated investment vehicles rather than direct ownership. This move signals increasing institutional interest in XRP and the broader crypto market.

title: QXO Stock Drifts Lower As Traders Weigh Profitability Path
summary: QXO Inc. stock is experiencing a downturn as traders assess its path to profitability despite multi-billion dollar revenue. Traders are closely watching key support levels around $15 to determine if the stock will defend its recent gains or slide back to previous levels.

title: QXO Stock Holds Support As Traders Weigh Path To Profitability
summary: QXO Inc. stock has pulled back by 3.4% amid investor concerns regarding its strategic restructuring plans, yet daily charts show potential higher lows forming, suggesting consolidation. Despite financial leverage, QXO has decent liquidity, and its current price action presents clear support and resistance levels, making it attractive for momentum and swing traders focused on risk management.

title: Deadline Alert: Pentair plc (PNR) Shareholders Who Lost

This strategic focus, combined with its blend of hardware and software, positions Emerson Electric as a steady performer, particularly appealing during uncertain market conditions.

summary: Nucor (NYSE:NUE) is drawing attention as a prominent steel producer ahead of upcoming inflation data, with equity benchmarks near record highs. The company, known for its diversified, scrap-based electric arc furnace steelmaking, serves various industrial sectors and its performance is closely watched as an indicator for the broader North American steel industry.

title: Is Nordson (NASDAQ:NDSN) Drawing Watch as AI Assembly Demand Meets a Cautious Session?
summary: Nordson (NASDAQ:NDSN), a mid-cap company specializing in precision dispensing and test equipment, is attracting attention as demand for AI assembly technologies grows. Despite a cautious market session ahead of inflation data, Nordson's diversified end-market model across industrial, medical, and electronics sectors helps it navigate cyclical demand and maintain stability.

title: Tesla files plans for proposed $10.1B Texas solar manufacturing plant
summary: Tesla has filed plans to build a massive $10.1 billion solar cell manufacturing plant in Fort Bend County, Texas, which would create over 9,700 permanent jobs. The project, dubbed "Project Crystal Sun," aims to make Texas a hub for domestic solar cell manufacturing. Tesla plans to begin construction this year and complete it by 2028, with operations starting in 2029, and CEO Elon Musk has previously expressed a goal of 100 gigawatts of domestic solar production.

summary: Raymond James Financial has raised its price target for Bank of Montreal (TSE:BMO) to C$268 from C$233.50, maintaining an "outperform" rating and implying a 4.73% upside. title: What Could Lift American Tower (NYSE:AMT) as S&P 500 Nears Records?
summary: American Tower (NYSE:AMT) is navigating market conditions characterized by rising Treasury yields, which typically challenge real estate investment trusts due to their sensitivity to financing costs. The article examines how AMT's long-term contracted revenue streams and global portfolio help it manage interest rate fluctuations, while also highlighting industry trends like energy management and the strategic balance between leverage and growth spending.

title: Sound Point Meridian Capital (NYSE:SPMC) Releases Quarterly Earnings Results, Misses Estimates By $0.06 EPS
summary: Sound Point Meridian Capital (NYSE:SPMC) reported quarterly earnings of $0.24 per share, missing consensus estimates by $0.06. summary: With AI-focused earnings beats and easing inflation, attention is returning to data centers and power infrastructure. Each company offers exposure to AI infrastructure demand, albeit with varying risk profiles related to valuation, debt, and operational specifics.

title: Monster Beverage (MNST) Stock Looks Near Fair Value While Earnings Price In More
summary: Monster Beverage (MNST) stock appears to be near fair value according to a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model, despite trading roughly 7.8% above the DCF estimate. title: The Bull Case For Southern (SO) Could Change Following Major Convertible Note Issuance And Stronger Earnings

title: Cardinal Health Earnings: Can Perfection Get Priced In Twice?
summary: Cardinal Health (CAH) saw its stock hit a new all-time high despite mixed Q4 fiscal year results, including a revenue miss and a decline in its Global Medical Products and Distribution unit. The company's growth is being driven by its high-margin cell-and-gene-therapy logistics business, which now exclusively serves nearly half of that market, projected to reach $106 billion by 2033. Analysts have raised price targets, and Cardinal Health maintains a 29-year streak of dividend increases, indicating continued investor confidence despite valuation concerns.

title: Agilent Receives FDA Approval for Expanded Use of PD-L1 IHC 22C3
summary: Agilent Technologies Inc. announced that the FDA has approved the expanded use of its PD-L1 IHC 22C3 pharmDx for Dako Omnis platform. This approval allows for identifying patients with esophageal squamous cell carcinoma, triple-negative breast cancer, cervical cancer, and gastric or gastroesophageal junction adenocarcinoma who may be eligible for KEYTRUDA treatment. The expansion aims to standardize testing on automated platforms, improving efficiency for pathology laboratories.

title: Thermo Fisher, Michael J. Fox Foundation Expand Parkinson’s Proteomics Resource with 5,500 Samples
summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific and The Michael J. Fox Foundation have expanded the Parkinson’s Precision Medicine Initiative (PPMI) proteomic data resource by analyzing approximately 5,500 research samples using Olink Explore HT technology. This large-scale, open-access dataset is now available in PPMI’s repository to the global research community. The initiative aims to accelerate biomarker discovery, disease subtyping, and precision medicine research in Parkinson's disease by providing deeper insights into its biological mechanisms and patient heterogeneity.

title: Johnson & Johnson vs AbbVie: Safe Dividend vs Higher Yield
summary: The article compares Johnson & Johnson (J&J) and AbbVie as investment options, focusing on their dividend characteristics and business strategies. The author recommends J&J for income investors seeking safety and AbbVie for those pursuing total return with a higher risk tolerance.

title: Johnson & Johnson vs AbbVie: Safe Dividend vs Higher Yield
summary: This article compares Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) and AbbVie (ABBV) for dividend investors, highlighting J&J's safer, diversified portfolio and 64-year dividend streak against AbbVie's higher yield but greater concentration in immunology.
